info.title: order-service API (code-derived)
info.description: Extracted by reading Spring controllers directly (tier 4). This is the CURRENT, verifiable surface of order-service: only two @RestController classes exist in src/main/java/kr/co/sellflow/order. The neighbouring openapi.json is a 2022 springdoc artefact retained for reference but is stale — see openapi.meta.json. Version taken from SERVER_VERSION (2.8.14); build.gradle still declares 2.8.4.

servers.description: server.port=8081 from application.yml; no context-path configured

post.description: OrderController.cancel -> OrderCancelService.cancel. Blocks only orders already in CHWISO or BANPUM; JUNGSAN_WANRYO (settled) orders ARE cancellable since SF-2287. Writes ORDER_CANCEL, flips ORDER_MST.SANGTAE_CD to CHWISO, and appends an order.cancelled row to ORDER_EVENT_OUTBOX.

409.description: OrderCancelNotAllowedException — order is already CHWISO or BANPUM. GlobalExceptionHandler comment: "409 로 내려간다. API 스펙 문서와 상태코드는 여기 기준."

500.description: Unknown sayuCd raises IllegalArgumentException in CancelReason.of — unhandled, so it surfaces as 500.

get.description: OrderSearchController.search -> OrderSearchService. Javadoc states a 3-month maximum range ("기간 최대 3개월") but no code enforces it. Under /api/** so WebConfig CORS restricts browser origins to https://admin.sellflow.co.kr.

200.description: List<OrderMst>. NOTE: the JdbcTemplate RowMapper is `(rs, i) -> null`, so every element is null at runtime.

sayuCd.description: 취소 사유 코드. CancelReason: 01 파트너 귀책, 02 시스템 오류, 03 고객 변심, 04 배송 실패.

OrderStatus.description: 결제완료 / 상품준비중 / 배송중 / 배송완료 / 정산완료 / 취소 / 반품. JUNGSAN_WANRYO is written only by settlement-batch's MarkSettledTasklet, never by this service.
